source.paraphrase: With strict: false, paths not in the schema are stored silently. The default keeps undeclared paths out of the database.

invariants.why: A non-strict schema stores whatever the client sends, so typos and injected fields persist without an error.
invariants.fixHint: Declare the paths on the schema, or use strict: "throw" so undeclared paths fail loudly instead of persisting.
invariants.avoid: Extra options beside strict do not cancel it. The file must import mongoose; strict: false in a body-parser or other options object in a file with no such import is not matched. This rule complements mass-assignment: that one guards the write call, this one guards the schema.

source.work: MongoDB Node.js driver docs (Connection pooling and server selection)
source.paraphrase: A bare connect() inherits the default pool size and waits the default timeout before failing over. Name both explicitly.

invariants.why: Default pool and timeout settings hang or overload under load instead of failing fast with a tuned budget.
invariants.fixHint: Pass maxPoolSize and serverSelectionTimeoutMS in the connect() options for the workload this service runs.
invariants.avoid: An empty options object sets nothing. Unrelated options such as dbName do not satisfy this rule. The file must import mongoose or mongodb. A connect call on a Redis or other client in a file with no such import is not matched. Any other connect call in a file that does import one is still matched.

source.locator: withTransaction() retry, commit, and abort behavior
source.paraphrase: withTransaction() retries the body on transient errors and always commits or aborts. A raw startTransaction() leaves that to the caller.

invariants.why: A raw transaction that throws mid-way stays open until it times out, holding locks and a session slot.
invariants.fixHint: Run the writes inside session.withTransaction() so commit, abort, and transient-error retry are automatic.
invariants.avoid: Renaming the session (sess) does not change the call. Passing { session } to a write outside withTransaction is still manual.

source.work: MongoDB Manual (Index builds on populated collections)
source.locator: index build cost and foreground behavior
source.paraphrase: Building an index scans the collection and competes with traffic. Declare indexes with the schema or a migration, not inline.

invariants.why: An index built from a request path runs at request time, blocking or slowing the collection it is supposed to speed up.
invariants.fixHint: Declare the index with schema.index() (Mongoose) or in a migration script that runs outside request handling.
invariants.avoid: Reaching the collection through db.collection() does not move the build out of code. ensureIndex() is the same call under an older name.
